title: world index
description: Written by the world builder to <world>/kantobridge/world_index.json and sent to clients in world.index parts. Maps cells to blocks and lists the story cells and habitat blocks. ROM-derived as a whole (map sizes, story cells).

exportHash.description: SHA-256 of the export bundle's index.json canonical JSON: which export built this world.

cellBlocks.description: Blocks per cell edge: a cell is 2x2 blocks, one 8x8 tile per block.

surfaceY.description: Feet level of the outdoor walking surface (64); ground blocks sit at surfaceY - 1.

layerStep.description: Interior layer k has its floor surface at surfaceY - layerStep * k.

x.description: Block X of the map's cell (0, 0) north-west corner.

y.description: Feet level (block Y) of the map's walking surface.

z.description: Block Z of the map's cell (0, 0) north-west corner.

layer.description: 0 for the surface; k >= 1 for interior layers.

kind.description: route: a Wild Routes zone's route map, placed at its trailhead (docs/specs/WILD_ROUTES_PLAN.md §4.2).

storyCells.description: Every cell that carries a story-cell block, with what decides whether it is closed for a player.

obj.description: object: the map object (toggle name) standing here.

swap.description: tile: the swap site (from the swaps export) this cell belongs to.

hidden.description: object: the object starts hidden (its map record's hidden default); left out when false.

start.description: tile: the map data's block at the swap site (before, or after where the engine stamps the site closed on map load); maps other than the hidden player's current one are taken to show it.

water.description: tile: the cell's open (built) state is water, closed unless the player surfs; left out when false.

closed.description: tile: the cell's closed state, in force while the live block at the site is block.

block.description: The closing block: the site's before, or its after where only before is walkable at this cell.

pass.description: Who crosses the closed cell: nobody, surfers, everybody (only its art differs).

height.description: Blocks of closed art above the floor block; 0 draws it flat on the floor.

art.description: Full-shape slot indices of the closed art: north-west, north-east, south-west, south-east.

zones.description: Wild Routes zones (docs/specs/WILD_ROUTES_PLAN.md §4.4), sorted by id; absent in a world built without any. Inside a zone's box the client sends no steps and the drift rule is off.

routeMap.description: The zone's route map: a maps entry of kind route.

y.description: The feet level of the zone's walkable floor.
